title.tr: Şerit pencereli iki katlı yatay ahşap cephe
title.en: Two-storey horizontal timber facade with ribbon windows

alt.tr: İki katlı binada yatay ahşap cephe kaplaması; alt katta şerit pencereler, ortada koyu bant
alt.en: Horizontal timber facade cladding on a two-storey building with ribbon windows on the ground floor and a dark band in the

caption.tr: Cephe yatay tahtalarla kaplı. Alt katta üst üste üç yatay pencere, ortada koyu bir bant var; önünde zemin henüz düzenlenmemiş.
caption.en: The facade is clad in horizontal boards. Three horizontal windows are stacked on the lower floor with a dark band above, and the ground in front is not yet landscaped.
